description: This file contains a Smarty plugin implementing a regex_replace modifier, which performs regular expression search and replace operations within the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs regex replace operations, handling single string or arrays of search patterns, with checks for dangerous patterns.

methods.name: _smarty_regex_replace_check
methods.description: Sanitizes the search pattern to prevent usage of eval-modifier by removing 'e' and other unwanted flags.
